ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be taught online. Students must have broadband access to the internet to participate. There will be one on-campus organizational meeting TBA to cover logistics and address any questions. This course will open to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, April 15, 2013 and to the campus on Monday, April 22, 2013 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
